acornbarnacle: A CLUSTER of acorn barnacles crowded together on a rock, each one a SQUAT VOLCANO-SHAPED CONE of hard chalky plates fused edge to edge, wider at the base than the top, with a DARK OPEN CIRCULAR APERTURE at the summit of each. The plates are boldly STRIPED AND STREAKED IN DEEP PURPLE AND CHALKY WHITE, running vertically down each cone, with rough ridged texture. A dozen or so packed at different angles and sizes. Isolated cluster on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
adaro: An adaro, a sea spirit with a human body and THE HEAD OF AN ORDINARY FISH - a blunt rounded fish head with a wide fish mouth, large round lidless fish eyes on the sides, and scaled cheeks. NOT a shark head, no pointed shark snout, no shark grin. Gill slits at the neck, a spined dorsal fin running along its spine, webbed hands, legs ending in broad fins, and a long SWORDFISH SPIKE projecting forward from the top of its head. Blue-green scaled skin. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
agropelter: A lanky forest creature with a compact furry brown-grey body, a small ape face with round staring eyes and a wide howling mouth, and EXACTLY TWO ARMS AND NO MORE - one left arm and one right arm, both enormously long, thin and ropy, many times the length of its body, each ending in a small three-fingered hand. Count them: two arms only. One arm is drawn back over its shoulder holding a heavy dead branch ready to throw. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
airavata: Airavata, a magnificent WHITE ELEPHANT with an ornately decorated hide of painted patterns and gold ornament, standing squarely with a SOLID UNBROKEN SILHOUETTE and its whole body opaque including the hindquarters and rear legs. It has EXACTLY TWO TUSKS, one on each side, and each tusk is a SINGLE SMOOTH UNBRANCHED CURVE - no extra tusks, no forking, no branching tines. Broad ears, a raised trunk. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
alicanto: An alicanto, a heavy ground-walking bird with metallic plumage that glimmers faintly like ore, walking on a rocky slope. It has EXACTLY ONE PAIR OF WINGS and they are BOTH SPREAD WIDE AND OPEN - there is no second pair, and no folded wings anywhere on its back or body. Two open wings, nothing else. A heavy hooked beak, sturdy legs, and a faint glow from the metal in its feathers. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
alkonost: An alkonost: the head and arms of a woman joined to the body, wings and legs of a great bird, perched gripping a branch. BRILLIANT MULTICOLOURED PLUMAGE - gold, deep red, teal and violet layered across the wings and tail. LARGE POWERFUL YELLOW BIRD FEET WITH LONG BLACK TALONS clutching the branch. Long flowing red hair and a calm human face, MODESTLY DRESSED with a feathered mantle covering her chest and shoulders. The feathered bird body begins at the waist. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
amarok: An amarok, an enormous lone wolf far larger than any real wolf, with a SOLID UNBROKEN OPAQUE SILHOUETTE and no gaps in its outline, thick shaggy grey-white winter coat, MASSIVE SHOULDERS AND JAWS, pale ice-blue eyes, breath steaming, standing four-square in a hunting stance. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
amaru: An amaru, an Andean composite creature with TWO HEADS - two separate necks rising side by side from one body, each ending in a distinct head, both clearly visible. A serpent's long coiling body, a condor's feathered wings, and a llama's hindquarters. Turquoise and gold scales, feathered shoulders. Both heads are the same size and equally detailed. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
americancurl: An American curl cat seen from a THREE-QUARTER FRONT VIEW, facing toward the viewer and slightly turned - its face and chest are visible and it is NOT seen from behind. A medium silky-coated cat whose one distinguishing feature is its EARS: set wide on the head and CURVING SMOOTHLY BACKWARD in an arc. It has EXACTLY ONE TAIL, a single plumed tail and no more. Sitting upright. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
amikuk: An amikuk, a huge alien sea monster that is NOT humanoid and has NO human features at all. Its body is a SMOOTH BULBOUS HOODED DOME of pale grey-green hide, ridged and hunched over with no neck, like an enormous eyeless head. Set low on the front of that dome is a WIDE SHARK-LIKE GRINNING MOUTH full of small sharp teeth and one small dark eye. From beneath the body hang FOUR IMMENSELY LONG THIN TAPERING LIMBS, smooth and boneless like drooping tentacles, each ending in two or three long hooked claws. No shoulders, no chest, no face. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
anglerfish: A deep-sea black seadevil anglerfish, a dark blackish-brown fish with a LARGE ANGULAR HEAD THAT IS NOT ROUNDED OR BALL-SHAPED. Its mouth has a CLEARLY DEFINED UPPER JAW AND LOWER JAW, and the LOWER JAW JUTS FORWARD BEYOND THE UPPER ONE, thrust out and prominent, giving it a heavy undershot underbite. Both jaws are lined with long thin needle fangs that interlock. Small dull eye, spiny fins, and a single long stalk rising from the forehead with a glowing bulb. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
angorarabbit: An Angora rabbit almost entirely BURIED IN AN ENORMOUS MASS OF LONG SILKY WHITE WOOL that hangs past its feet and swallows its outline, with a SOLID UNBROKEN OPAQUE SILHOUETTE and no gaps or holes anywhere in the wool. Only the dark eyes, small nose and woolly ear tufts show. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
ankylosaurus: Ankylosaurus, a heavily armoured quadrupedal dinosaur covered in rows of bony plates and spikes, with a large bony club at the tip of its tail. ITS NECK IS VERY SHORT AND THICK - the broad low head sits almost directly against the shoulders with barely any neck visible at all, not on a long reaching neck. Squat wide body, short stout legs, standing side-on. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
anomalocaris: An Anomalocaris, a large Cambrian swimming predator with a segmented tubular body edged along both sides by a ROW OF OVERLAPPING FLEXIBLE SWIMMING FLAPS, a pair of large spined grasping appendages at the front, a circular plated mouth, and two stalked eyes. Banded orange and cream. Isolated creature on a plain empty background with absolutely nothing behind it, no panel, no frame, no card, no plate
apep: Apep, an enormous dark serpent, drawn as ONE SINGLE CLEAN CONTINUOUS BODY in a simple readable S-CURVE - the body must never cross over itself, never pass through itself, and never tangle into knots. One head at one end, a tapering tail at the other, and the whole length traceable from head to tail without ambiguity. Glinting dark scales with a faint red sheen. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
arcticfox: An adult Arctic fox standing squarely on all four legs in profile, with a SOLID UNBROKEN OPAQUE SILHOUETTE and no gaps or holes in its outline or coat, a thick white winter coat, short rounded ears, a short blunt muzzle and a very bushy tail. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
oryx: An Arabian oryx standing on all four legs in STRICT SIDE PROFILE, with a SOLID UNBROKEN OPAQUE SILHOUETTE and no gaps or holes anywhere in its body or legs. A compact chalk-white antelope with dark chocolate legs, a dark facial mask, and TWO VERY LONG STRAIGHT SLENDER RINGED HORNS sweeping back. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
asanbosam: An asanbosam, a GAUNT LONG-LIMBED HUMANOID rather than an ape - narrow shouldered, wiry and skeletal with ashen grey skin stretched tight over bones, NOT a heavy gorilla and NOT muscular. It hangs upside down from a branch. ITS LEGS END IN CURVED IRON HOOKS OF DARK FORGED METAL - there are NO FEET, NO TOES AND NO ANKLES AT ALL, the shins simply terminate in hooks of hard metal that grip the branch. Very long thin arms hang downward, a wide mouth of iron teeth, red eyes. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
ayeaye: An aye-aye clinging to a branch, a strange lemur with shaggy coarse dark brown-black fur flecked with pale guard hairs, HUGE ROUND ORANGE-YELLOW STARING EYES, and LARGE ROUNDED FURRY DARK EARS held out from the head - rounded and furred, not thin bat wings. A pale grizzled face, prominent rodent-like front incisors, and ONE EXTREMELY LONG THIN SKELETAL MIDDLE FINGER on each hand, far longer and thinner than the others. An enormously long thick bushy tail, longer than its body. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
